title: Stockholm Telephone Tower

buildingCutout.basis: Hide the two containing modern Gallerian building pieces when the historical exchange is active.

note: The reconstruction represents the original exchange and decorated telephone tower during the 1890s before the 1898 extension. The cadastral plan supplies widths and depth, and Stockholm’s 1887 engineering article gives the main lattice dimensions. Color, ridge-street elevation, light-well details and decorative ironwork are reconstructed from period images. Insulators and short wire leads convey the rooftop network without extending cables across the modern city. The viewer uses its historical-date opt-in. Present-day buildings and terrain in the surrounding blocks use modern map data. Historical placement requires an explicit viewingDate within the recorded appearance interval; excluded from the default current world.
